body:
Username- V3N0M0U5_G4M1NG
Reason for ban- Inappropriate website.
Reason why I should be unbanned- I have learned my lesson and it was thought to be a joke at the time but I realized after that avicus is a server for all ages and that i shouldn't do that.
How long ago was it- 3-5 months.

My ban was true and I have nothing against why I was permanently banned but I really miss the server and I miss the people on the server. I also like the competitive feel when I get on and how the rules are fair. I am truly sorry for what I have done and I hope I get unbanned.  I will not do it again.
Venomous Gaming
